# RK Group

Official website: https://example.com/

## About
RK Group is a Lahore-based startup focused on cleaning materials, janitorial supplies, hygiene solutions and waste-management enquiries. All products and services use one RK Group identity.

## Service Categories
- Cleaning Chemicals & Materials: Cleaning chemicals and consumable materials for routine maintenance, hygiene and facility-cleaning applications.
- Janitorial Supplies: Mops, wipers, brushes, brooms, tissue products and everyday janitorial essentials for commercial and institutional environments.
- Cleaning Equipment: Cleaning equipment and accessories for the maintenance of offices, commercial buildings, industrial facilities and shared spaces.
- Janitorial & Cleaning Services: Cleaning and janitorial solutions for facilities requiring structured housekeeping, routine maintenance or other hygiene-related services.
- Industrial Cleaning Materials: Materials and cleaning-related supplies intended for industrial environments, operational areas and facility-maintenance requirements.
- Industrial Waste Management: Solutions for industrial waste-related requirements, with service scope and handling arrangements assessed according to the waste category and applicable requirements.
- Medical Waste Management: Enquiry and assessment support for healthcare waste-management requirements, subject to confirmation of authorised service arrangements and applicable safeguards.
- Commercial Waste Management: Waste-management solutions for commercial properties, business premises, shopping centres and other managed facilities.
- Residential & Housing Society Waste Management: Waste-management solutions intended to address the requirements of housing societies and residential communities.

## Purpose
Together for a Cleaner & Greener Pakistan.
